author: TeIq
content: Closed. New xtask command 'cargo xtask check-wasm-budget' asserts release wasm raw-bytes ≤ POLARIS_WASM_BUDGET_BYTES (default 2 MiB). Current baseline: 1.4 MB raw (66% of budget). Live run output: 'check-wasm-budget: 1393307 bytes raw (66% of 2097152)'. 3 unit tests cover under-budget pass, over-budget error, missing-artifact error-with-hint. Gzip-side gate dropped — operator CDN compression is environment-dependent. CI step wired into wasm-build job after check-wasm-symbols. Build + clippy + fmt clean.
